sentences.say: After a flood, not every family needs the same things.
One may need medicine; another, transport or temporary rent.
When local shops are working and essentials are available, well-run cash assistance lets people choose what they need.
If markets are disrupted, supplies may be more useful.
Before giving, check what a trusted local organisation requests.
Effective help starts with actual needs, not with what is easiest for us to donate.
